# `smelt.permissions`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Everywhere, including headless mode.

Decide which agent tool calls run, ask, or are denied. Modes set how much a call may do; path rules (`smelt.permissions.paths`) set where. Wrap `smelt.permissions.check(call)` to change the policy. Approvals last until the session ends.

## `smelt.permissions.allow`

```lua
fun(tool: string, access: smelt.permissions.Access): nil
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Access`](types.md#smeltpermissionsaccess)

Let `tool` run at up to `access` without asking until the session ends.

## `smelt.permissions.allow_path`

```lua
fun(path: string, access: smelt.permissions.Access): nil
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Access`](types.md#smeltpermissionsaccess)

Let calls that touch only paths beneath `path` run at up to `access` without asking until the session ends. A `deny` rule still wins.

## `smelt.permissions.allowed`

```lua
fun(tool: string, access: smelt.permissions.Access): boolean
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Access`](types.md#smeltpermissionsaccess)

Return true when the user approved `tool` at `access` or more this session.

## `smelt.permissions.allowed_path`

```lua
fun(path: string, access: smelt.permissions.Access): boolean
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Access`](types.md#smeltpermissionsaccess)

Return true when the user approved a directory holding `path` at `access` or more this session.

## `smelt.permissions.check`

```lua
fun(call: smelt.permissions.Call): "allow"|"ask"|"deny"
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Call`](types.md#smeltpermissionscall)

Decide one tool call: "allow" runs it, "ask" prompts the user and "deny"
blocks it. Replace this function to change the policy, and call the
previous value to keep the default for everything else. Calls that touch
a `deny` path never reach it.

## `smelt.permissions.clear`

```lua
fun(): nil
```

Forget every session approval, for tools and for paths.

## `smelt.permissions.path_access`

```lua
fun(path: string, intent: smelt.permissions.Intent, mode?: string?): smelt.permissions.Access?
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Intent`](types.md#smeltpermissionsintent), [`smelt.permissions.Access`](types.md#smeltpermissionsaccess)

Return the access a call needs to read or write `path` in `mode` (default: the current mode), or nil when a `deny` rule forbids it. `allow` paths need `"read"` to read and `"write"` to write; paths with no rule need `"full"` to write; `ask` paths need `"full"` for both. Writing a session artifact, such as a plan, needs only `"read"`.

## `smelt.permissions.paths`

```lua
fun(rules?: table<string, smelt.permissions.Rule|false>?, opts?: smelt.permissions.PathsOpts?): table<string, smelt.permissions.Rule>
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Rule`](types.md#smeltpermissionsrule), [`smelt.permissions.PathsOpts`](types.md#smeltpermissionspathsopts)

Set path rules and return the rules of the layer. `rules` maps a path or glob to a rule, or to `false` to remove one. Each call merges into the rules already set, for every mode or only for `opts.modes`. `~` is the home directory, relative paths start at the project, and `*`, `?` and `**` make a glob (`**/x` matches anywhere). The rule that names the closest ancestor of a path wins; at the same depth a mode rule wins, then the longer pattern.

## `smelt.permissions.rule`

```lua
fun(path: string, mode?: string?): smelt.permissions.Rule?
```

Types: [`smelt.permissions.Rule`](types.md#smeltpermissionsrule)

Return the rule for `path` in `mode` (default: the current mode), or nil when no rule names it. The workspace, the temp directories and the session artifacts are `"allow"`. Relative paths resolve against the project cwd.
